speech.heard: In Germany, public employee pay takes 5.7% of expenses. In Botswana, it's 54%. Belgium and Spain sit near the bottom at 5.9%. The USA spends 8.1% of its budget on civil servants. Climbing higher, Honduras spends 48.6%. Central African Republic 49.9%, Iraq 51.9% and Botswana 54%. Mozambique takes the top spot with 62%, the world's highest. Mozambique spends 7.7 times the share that the USA does. How much of your government's budget goes to public pay?
